openai_gpt41_mini.selection_rationale: Different vendor from DeepSeek; closest wire-level match to the frozen runner (temperature, max_tokens, strict JSON schema, native parallel tool calls), so observed differences are least likely to come from interface configuration.

google_gemini3_flash.selection_rationale: Second independent vendor via the documented OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Strict-schema and multi-turn tool-call behaviour on the compatibility layer is the main interface risk; adapter pre-downgrades to json_object and a fixture-level live smoke (2 cells) is required before the full run.
google_gemini3_flash.reasoning_cost_note: reasoning tokens billed as output; envelope output x1.0-4.0 on the wave21 token mix; BudgetGuard pre-call cap bounds the high side
known_risks: compatibility-layer strict json_schema support has historically been incomplete
thinking tokens are billed inside output tokens; real cost may exceed the wave21-token-based estimate
preview model id can be retired across Gemini minor releases

openai_gpt51_codex_mini.selection_rationale: Code-review-tuned third candidate exercising the max_completion_tokens / no-temperature / reasoning_effort adaptation path. Only if the user wants a second OpenAI-family point; gpt-4.1-mini remains the controlled primary.
openai_gpt51_codex_mini.reasoning_cost_note: reasoning tokens billed as output; envelope output x1.0-4.0 on the wave21 token mix; BudgetGuard pre-call cap bounds the high side

interface_compatibility_matrix.primary_alignment: gpt-4.1-mini supports all five natively; it is the controlled replication (minimum interface delta)
interface_compatibility_matrix.gemini_mitigations: adapter pre-downgrades strict->json_object; 2-cell live fixture smoke (one static, one active condition) is MANDATORY and separately approved before all 110
interface_compatibility_matrix.codex_mitigations: adapter swaps to max_completion_tokens, drops temperature, sets reasoning_effort=minimal

cost_envelope_and_budget_guard.budgetguard: ev1 live path performs a BudgetGuard pre-call check; a 4xx/5xx or cap breach is recorded, not retried blindly; runs are resumable
